title: The Slow Horizon Anew
author: Coral Sandoval
blurb: Edmund Dravenmoor, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
